∀ {d : ℕ} {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (T : OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.Tree) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (gamma : ℝ)
  (x0 : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d)
  (k i : ℕ),
  i < k →
    ∃ F,
      Measurable F ∧
        ∀ (η : ℕ → Ω),
          η (T.auxSample m i) =
            F fun l =>
              (T.vertex gamma x0 g η (m (↑l + 1)), T.vertex gamma x0 g η (T.auxNode m (↑l + 1)), η (T.auxSample m ↑l))
